trace.answer_for_eval:
The steps to request a Transcript of Records are as follows:

1. Fill out and endorse the request slip (LSPU-REG-SF-011), which involves:
   - Issues the request slip
   - Reviews and checks the accomplished request against the student's clearance
   - Assesses the corresponding fees of the requested documents
   - Undergraduates fill out the request slip with clearance and secure signatures of heads of responsible offices; graduates fill out the same request slip
   - Time required: 5 minutes

2. Pay the required fees at the Cashier's Office, which involves:
   - Receiving payment and issuing an official receipt
   - Fees vary depending on the document:
     - Transcript of Records: P75.00/page (undergraduate), P150.00/page (graduate)
     - Certifications: P30.00/page
     - Authentication: P30.00/page
     - 2nd copy of Diploma: P100.00
   - Time required: 2 minutes

3. Submit the receipt and request slip, receive the claim stub, and document preparation, which involves:
   - Receiving and reviewing the presented receipt and request slip
   - Scheduling the date of release
   - Issuing claim stub
   - Locating the permanent record
   - Preparing and encoding the requested document
   - Reviewing and counterchecking entries
   - Printing the final document
   - Affixing the college seal
   - Signing the document
   - Time required: up to 59 minutes total (including locating record, preparing/encoding, review, printing, sealing, signing)

4. Claim the requested document on the scheduled date indicated on the claim stub, which involves:
   - Claiming the document
   - Time required: 2 minutes
